edges.reason: Addition facts support a fast inverse strategy and checks. Crossing out objects or counting back computes a difference without invoking the matching addition fact.
Subtraction within ten contains the smaller subtractions within five as cases of the same subtraction operation.
Tens-and-ones composition includes the meaning of a teen number as one ten and units. This overlapping place-value content is necessary without prescribing the historical order of lessons.

Mental addition prepares place-value decomposition and inverse checks. Borrowing and teen-subtraction facts compute a mental difference directly, so an entire mental-addition procedure is not necessary.
edges.scope: two-digit subtraction as inverse of addition

edges.reason: Borrowing in general two-digit subtraction includes teen-minus-two-through-five subtractions in the units stage.
